findings.summary: U10 evidence is still absent, and this is the exact failure mode the spec names as the single most important rule of the package (§0: '评审判过 ≠ 命令跑过'; the prior development FAILED dd acceptance because npm test was red despite a clean final review). Spec U10 mandates '⛔ 必须实跑并贴完整尾部输出（Test Files / Tests 两行 + 有无 FAIL 段）' in a clean environment with DOC_CHANNEL / RESEARCH_ORIGIN unset. The dev-note pastes only a two-line fragment ('Test Files 22 passed (22)' / 'Tests 409 passed (409)') with no command line, no indication that the run was performed with DOC_CHANNEL and RESEARCH_ORIGIN unset, and no presence/absence statement for a FAIL section. The identical major finding was raised against attempt 1 (rc-attempt_01KZKGPQDPZQZ3QD2DYDX7B0QH) and the remedy applied here is a bare count restatement, not the mandated tail output. As a read-only reviewer I cannot execute the command, so this evidence gap leaves the package's decisive acceptance criterion unverified.

U5 has no positive export-landing test. Spec U5 requires '导出落点 <EXPORT_ROOT>/DeepThought/<主题-slug>/…；EXPORT_ROOT 未配置 ⇒ 响亮失败；父目录自动创建' verified by '正反两例'. The negative case exists, but it does not exercise production code: the test hand-writes its own spawnExport stub that merely re-checks process.env.EXPORT_ROOT and throws, rather than driving the production assembleGenerateDeps spawnExport at src/tick-run.ts:1325-1357 — so deleting the production EXPORT_ROOT guard would not be detected. The positive half asserts only deriveExportPath, a pure function, and never asserts that the mandated mkdirSync(dirname(path), {recursive:true}) at src/export.ts:100 actually creates the parent directory, which spec §2.3(1) flags as a guaranteed first-real-export ENOENT.

U1 reachability is never proven against the production dependency assembly. Every runChannelWrite call in the U1 positive and negative cases passes an injected generateDeps, which makes runChannelWrite take the opts.generateDeps branch at src/tick-run.ts:1561 and skip assembleGenerateDeps entirely. This is structurally the same zero-power shape the spec calls out for U7 ('所有用例都自建 GenerateDeps 注入自己的 stub，生产默认从未被执行'). U7 was repaired by the direct assembleGenerateDeps test at test/g4c-generate-wiring.test.ts:614-630, but no equivalent exists for the reachability edge: nothing asserts that a production --run invocation without an injected generateDeps reaches runGenerate through the assembled production deps.

Production export topic silently defaults instead of failing loudly. assembleGenerateDeps builds the ExportInput with 'topic: opts.question ?? "untitled"', so a --run invocation that reaches the generation phase without --question produces an export path derived from the literal slug 'untitled' (deriveExportPath at src/export.ts:55-59 puts the slug in both the directory and the filename). The spec's repeated discipline for missing configuration in this package is a loud failure rather than a fabricated stand-in value (§2.3(3) for EXPORT_ROOT, §2.7 for --doc-channel); note that the sibling readQuestion at src/tick-run.ts:1275-1278 does throw for the same missing value, so the two paths disagree on the same input.
